title: Congressional report on the 1944 Maison Rouge meeting

tellings.quote: The US Congress published in June of 1945 before the war in Asia was over. They published a report on basically what was the Maison Rouge meeting that happened in 1944 uh in Straborg.

plain: The writer and researcher Peter Levenda says the US Congress published a report in June 1945, before the war in Asia was over, about what was in effect the Maison Rouge meeting, a gathering held in 1944 in Strasbourg, France. Levenda summarises this himself without naming who pointed him to it. He brings it up as an official record that the meeting took place and that Congress knew of it.
